Guide\n\nA small, deterministic HTTP service for D&D 5e helper calculations, combat\ntracking, campaign management, and play-by-post turn handling. It uses Rust\n1.97.0 and the standard library only: no external crates, no serde, no HTTP\nframework. HTTP is implemented directly on `std::net::TcpListener` /\n`TcpStream`, and JSON is built and parsed with string manipulation.\n\n## Quick start\n\n```bash\nPORT=8080 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` removes the local database (`game.db`), builds the server with\n`cargo run`, and starts it in the foreground. The server binds to `127.0.0.1`\non the port given by the `PORT` environment variable (default `8080`). The\ndatabase path can be overridden with `DB_PATH`.\n\nVerify the server is listening:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:8080/health\n# => {\"ok\":true}\n```\n\nReset the database and in-memory caches (registered user accounts are\npreserved so the authenticated play surface remains usable):\n\n```bash\ncurl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/storage/reset\n# => {\"ok\":true,\"schema_version\":1}\n```\n\n## Entry point and module layout\n\n- `Cargo.toml` — package metadata. No external dependencies.\n- `run.sh` — builds and runs the server with `cargo run`.\n- `src/main.rs` — entry point, module declarations, global state, and the\n  central request dispatcher. Routing is split into `dispatch_get`,\n  `dispatch_post`, `dispatch_put`, and `dispatch_delete` helpers.\n- `src/domain.rs` — core domain types (`Combatant`, `CombatSession`, `User`,\n  `Condition`) and the global in-memory caches (`SESSIONS`, `USERS`).\n- `src/http.rs` — minimal HTTP/1.1 request parsing and response writing.\n- `src/json.rs` — hand-rolled JSON parsing helpers used by every handler.\n  Recent refactoring introduced `find_value_pos` and `scan_bracket_content` to\n  share the key-location and bracket-matching logic across all extractors.\n- `src/store.rs` — SQLite persistence via the `sqlite3` CLI tool, plus all\n  existence and lookup helpers used by the domain modules. Startup migrations\n  are consolidated through `add_column_if_missing` so older schemas can be\n  forward-migrated without changing behavior for new databases.\n- `src/auth.rs` — registration, login, and bearer-token verification.\n- `src/combat.rs` — combat sessions, initiative, conditions, and turn\n  advancement.\n- `src/campaigns.rs` — campaigns, player characters, events, scheduled\n  sessions, attendance, audit, and export.\n- `src/compendium.rs` — monsters and items stored in SQLite.\n- `src/dice.rs` — dice statistics and ability checks.\n- `src/encounters.rs` — encounter difficulty / XP calculations.\n- `src/phb.rs` — Player's Handbook rules: modifiers, proficiency, spell slots,\n  rests, and equipment load.\n- `src/dm_tools.rs` — DM-facing helpers: encounter builder, loot parcel, and\n  session recap.\n- `src/quests.rs` — quest creation, progress tracking, and summaries.\n- `src/npcs_factions.rs` — factions and NPCs with relationship summaries.\n- `src/inventory.rs` — campaign inventory and character equipment assignments.\n- `src/downtime.rs` — downtime crafting projects.\n- `src/analytics.rs` — campaign readiness score and risk reports.\n- `src/play.rs` — authenticated play-by-post campaigns: membership, turn\n  queue, narrations, actions, resolutions, nudges, the role-filtered campaign\n  document, scenes, locations, travel, rests, encounter management, character\n  ownership, character creation, level progression, and skill checks. Path\n  parsing is centralized on small helpers (`parse_play_suffix`,\n  `parse_play_nested`, `parse_play_encounter_base`, `parse_play_encounter_resource`)\n  to keep the dozens of similar route patterns consistent.\n\n## State, persistence, and routing\n\n### In-memory state\n\nTwo global `LazyLock<Mutex<HashMap<...>>>` caches live in `src/domain.rs`:\n\n- `SESSIONS` — `HashMap<String, CombatSession>` for active combat encounters.\n- `USERS` — `HashMap<String, User>` for registered accounts.\n\nThese caches are locked at the start of every request in `dispatch_request` and\nheld until the response is written. This serializes requests and keeps the\nin-memory view consistent with the database between `save_storage` calls.\n\n### Persistence\n\nPersistence is implemented in `src/store.rs` by invoking the `sqlite3` command\nline tool. The schema is created by `init_db()` on startup if it does not exist.\n\nMutable state is saved with a simple “delete all, then re-insert all” strategy:\n`save_storage` deletes every row from `users`, `combat_sessions`, `combatants`,\nand `conditions`, then re-inserts the current contents of `SESSIONS` and\n`USERS`. This is intentionally simple and deterministic. The database is loaded\nonce at startup by `load_storage`.\n\nOther tables (`campaigns`, `characters`, `events`, `monsters`, `items`,\n`monster_tags`, `quests`, `quest_milestones`, `factions`, `npcs`,\n`campaign_inventory`, `character_equipment`, `crafting_projects`,\n`campaign_sessions`, `session_agenda`, `session_attendance`, `play_campaigns`,\n`play_campaign_members`, `play_narrations`, `play_campaign_documents`,\n`play_scenes`, `play_locations`, `play_location_connections`, `play_encounters`,\n`play_encounter_monsters`, `play_encounter_combatants`,\n`play_encounter_conditions`, `play_encounter_order`, `play_encounter_loot`) are\nwritten directly by their respective handlers and do not go through the\nin-memory caches. The storage reset endpoint preserves the `users` cache so\nthat authenticated play sessions remain identifiable across resets.\n\n### Startup migrations\n\n`init_db()` runs a set of small, additive migrations after creating the schema.\nEach migration checks the existing `PRAGMA table_info` output and adds missing\ncolumns with safe defaults. They are implemented through the shared helper\n`add_column_if_missing`, so adding a future migration is a single function call.\n\n### Request routing\n\n`src/main.rs` reads the request line, extracts the body, acquires both global\nlocks, and dispatches to the appropriate handler. The dispatcher uses a\nmethod-based split (`dispatch_get`, `dispatch_post`, `dispatch_put`,\n`dispatch_delete`) plus helper parsers for dynamic path segments:\n\n- `combat::parse_combat_path` for `/v1/combat/sessions/{id}/...`\n- `campaigns::parse_campaign_path` for `/v1/campaigns/{id}/...`\n- `campaigns::parse_campaign_session_path` for session attendance paths.\n- `quests::parse_campaign_quest_path` and `parse_quest_progress_path`.\n- `inventory::parse_campaign_inventory_path`, `parse_inventory_summary_path`,\n  and `parse_character_equipment_path`.\n- `downtime::parse_crafting_path` and `parse_crafting_advance_path`.\n- `play::parse_play_campaign_path` for `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/...`.\n- `play::parse_play_campaign_scene_path`, `parse_play_campaign_location_path`,\n  and `parse_play_campaign_character_path` for nested play resources.\n- `play::parse_play_encounter_*` helpers for encounter-related routes.\n- `strip_prefix` for `/v1/compendium/monsters/{slug}` and items.\n\nAuthorization is enforced by `require_auth` in `src/main.rs`, which checks the\n`Authorization: Bearer session-{username}` header and verifies the registered\nrole (`dm`, `player`, or any role). After a handler that mutates `SESSIONS` or\n`USERS` succeeds, the dispatcher calls `save_storage` to persist the change.\n\n### JSON parsing\n\n`src/json.rs` provides a small, serde-free parser. All keyed extractors build on\n`find_value_pos`, which locates the first `\"key\"` and the following colon, and\n`scan_bracket_content`, which extracts balanced bracket bodies. The public\nhelpers are:\n\n- `extract_string` / `extract_int` / `extract_bool` — scalar fields.\n- `extract_array_content` / `extract_object_content` — nested bodies.\n- `extract_top_array_content` — top-level SQLite JSON-mode arrays.\n- `extract_objects` — split an object sequence into individual `{...}` strings.\n- `extract_string_array` — strict quoted-string array parsing.\n\nThe parser does not handle escaped quotes inside string values; all inputs are\nexpected to be simple JSON objects produced by the test harness.\n\n## API / domain groupings\n\n| Area | Endpoints | Module |\n|------|-----------|--------|\n| Health & storage | `GET /health`, `GET /v1/storage/status`, `POST /v1/storage/reset` | `src/main.rs`, `src/store.rs` |\n| Auth | `POST /v1/auth/register`, `POST /v1/auth/login` | `src/auth.rs` |\n| Dice | `POST /v1/dice/stats`, `POST /v1/checks/ability` | `src/dice.rs` |\n| Initiative | `POST /v1/initiative/order` | `src/combat.rs` |\n| Characters / PHB | requests.\nfn dispatch_post(\n    path: &str,\n    body: &str,\n    req: &str,\n    sessions: &mut HashMap<String, CombatSession>,\n    users: &mut HashMap<String, User>,\n) -> (u16, String) {\n    match path {\n        \"/v1/storage/reset\" => {\n            if let Err(e) = reset_db() {\n                eprintln!(\"reset storage failed: {}\", e);\n                (500, r#\"{\"error\":\"reset failed\"}\"#.to_string())\n            } else {\n                sessions.clear();\n                // Preserve registered user accounts across storage reset so that\n                // the authenticated play surface can still identify DMs/players\n                // established earlier in the cumulative test suite.\n                (200, r#\"{\"ok\":true,\"schema_version\":1}\"#.to_string())\n            }\n        }\n        \"/v1/auth/register\" => match auth::handle_register(body, users) {\n            Ok(resp) => {\n                let _ = save_storage(sessions, users);\n                (201, resp)\n            }\n            Err(auth::RegisterError::Conflict) => {\n                (409, r#\"{\"error\":\"duplicate username\"}\"#.to_string())\n            }\n            Err(auth::RegisterError::BadRequest) => (400, BAD_REQUEST.to_string()),\n        },\n        \"/v1/auth/login\" => match auth::handle_login(body, users) {\n            Ok(resp) => (200, resp),\n            Err(auth::LoginError::Unauthorized) => (401, r#\"{\"error\":\"unauthorized\"}\"#.to_string()),\n            Err(auth::LoginError::BadRequest) => (400, BAD_REQUEST.to_string()),\n        },\n        \"/v1/dice/stats\" => option_response(dice::handle_dice_stats(body)),\n        \"/v1/checks/ability\" => option_response(dice::handle_ability_check(body)),\n        \"/v1/encounters/adjusted-xp\" => option_response(encounters::handle_encounter(body)),\n        \"/v1/initiative/order\" => option_response(combat::handle_initiative(body)),\n        \"/v1/characters/ability-modifier\" => option_response(phb::handle_ability_modifier(body)),\n        \"/v1/characters/proficiency\" => option_response(phb::handle_proficiency(body)),\n        \"/v1/characters/derived-stats\" => option_response(phb::handle_derived_stats(body)),\n        \"/v1/phb/spell-slots\" => option_response(phb::handle_spell_slots(body)),\n        \"/v1/phb/rests/long\" => option_response(phb::handle_long_rest(body)),\n        \"/v1/phb/equipment-load\" => option_response(phb::handle_equipment_load(body)),\n        \"/v1/combat/sessions\" => match combat::create_session(body, sessions) {\n            Some(resp) => {\n                let _ = save_storage(sessions, users);\n                (200, resp)\n            }\n            None => (400, BAD_REQUEST.to_string()),\n        },\n        \"/v1/compendium/monsters\" => match compendium::handle_create_monster(body) {\n            Ok(resp) => (201, resp),\n            Err(compendium::CompendiumError::Conflict) => {\n                (409, r#\"{\"error\":\"duplicate slug\"}\"#.to_string())\n            }\n            Err(compendium::CompendiumError::BadRequest) => (400, BAD_REQUEST.to_string()),\n            Err(compendium::CompendiumError::NotFound) => (404, NOT_FOUND.to_string()),\n        },\n        \"/v1/compendium/items\" => match compendium::handle_create_item(body) {\n            Ok(resp) => (201, resp),\n            Err(compendium::CompendiumError::Conflict) => {\n                (409, r#\"{\"error\":\"duplicate slug\"}\"#.to_string())\n            }\n            Err(compendium::CompendiumError::BadRequest) => (400, BAD_REQUEST.to_string()),\n            Err(compendium::CompendiumError::NotFound) => (404, NOT_FOUND.to_string()),\n        },\n        \"/v1/play/campaigns\" => match require_auth(req, users, AuthRequirement::Dm) {\n            Ok(owner) => match play::create_play_campaign(body, &owner) {\n                Ok(resp) => {\n                    let _ = save_storage(sessions, users);\n                    (201, resp)\n                }\n                Err(play::PlayError::Conflict) => {\n                    (409, r#\"{\"error\":\"duplicate play campaign id\"}\"#.to_string())\n                }\n                Err(play::PlayError::NotFound) => (404, NOT_FOUND.to_string()),\n                Err(play::PlayError::Forbidden) => (403, FORBIDDEN.to_string()),\n                Err(play::PlayError::BadRequest) => (400, BAD_REQUEST.to_string()),\n            },\n            Err(e) => auth_error(e),\n        },\n        \"/v1/campaigns\" => match campaigns::create_campaign(body) {\n            Ok(resp) => (201, resp),\n            Err(campaigns::CampaignError::Conflict) => {\n                (409, r#\"{\"error\":\"duplicate campaign id\"}\"#.to_string())\n            }\n            Err(campaigns::CampaignError::BadRequest) => (400, BAD_REQUEST.to_string()),\n            Err(campaigns::CampaignError::NotFound) => (404, option_response(dm_tools::handle_dm_loot_parcel(body)),\n        \"/v1/dm/session-recap\" => option_response(dm_tools::handle_dm_session_recap(body)),\n        _ => dispatch_dynamic_post(path, body, req, sessions, users),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Dispatch dynamic POST routes that include path parameters.\nfn dispatch_dynamic_post(\n    path: &str,\n    body: &str,\n    req: &str,\n    sessions: &mut The party must not already be full.\n/// Only players are allowed to join.\npub fn join_campaign(campaign_id: &str, body: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    let character_id = extract_string(body, \"character_id\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let name = extract_string(body, \"name\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let class = extract_string(body, \"class\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if character_id.is_empty() || name.is_empty() || class.is_empty() || actor.is_empty() {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n\n    let max_players = play_campaign_max_players(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let member_count =\n        play_campaign_member_count(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if member_count >= max_players {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    if play_campaign_member_exists(campaign_id, actor).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    if play_campaign_character_id_exists(campaign_id, character_id)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?\n    {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n\n    play_campaign_member_create(campaign_id, actor, character_id, name, class)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"username\":\"{}\",\"character_id\":\"{}\",\"name\":\"{}\",\"class\":\"{}\"}}\"#,\n        escape_json(actor),\n        escape_json(character_id),\n        escape_json(name),\n        escape_json(class)\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Append a GM narration to a play campaign.\n///\n/// POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/narrations\n///\n/// Only the campaign owner may narrate. The first member by\n/// insertion order becomes the current actor at turn number 1.\npub fn start_campaign(campaign_id: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    let (owner, status) =\n        play_campaign_owner_status(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if owner != actor {\n        return Err(PlayError::Forbidden);\n    }\n    if status != \"lobby\" {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    let members = play_campaign_members(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if members.len() < 2 {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    let current_actor = &members[0].0;\n    play_campaign_start(campaign_id, current_actor, \"player\", 1)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"id\":\"{}\",\"status\":\"active\",\"current_actor\":\"{}\",\"turn_number\":1}}\"#,\n        escape_json(campaign_id),\n        escape_json(current_actor)\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Read the caller's player turn context for a play campaign.\n///\n/// GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/my-turn\n///\n/// Only a campaign member with role `player` may read their own context.\n/// The response includes whether it is the caller's turn, the current actor,\n/// the caller's own character (id and name only), and recent public events.\n/// DM-private document fields are never exposed.\npub fn get_my_turn(campaign_id: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    if !play_campaign_member_exists(campaign_id, actor).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::Forbidden);\n    }\n    let (current_actor, _phase, _turn_number) =\n        play_campaign_get_turn(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let (character_id, character_name) =\n        play_campaign_member_character(campaign_id, actor).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let narrations = play_campaign_narrations(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n\n    let is_my_turn = current_actor == actor;\n    let mut events_json = Vec::new();\n    for (sequence, kind, event_actor, text) in narrations {\n        events_json.push(format!(\n            r#\"{{\"sequence\":{},\"kind\":\"{}\",\"actor\":\"{}\",\"text\":\"{}\"}}\"#,\n            sequence,\n            escape_json(&kind),\n            escape_json(&event_actor),\n            escape_json(&text)\n        ));\n    }\n\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"is_my_turn\":{},\"current_actor\":\"{}\",\"character\":{{\"id\":\"{}\",\"name\":\"{}\"}},\"recent_events\":[{}]}}\"#,\n        is_my_turn,\n        escape_json(&current_actor),\n        escape_json(&character_id),\n        escape_json(&character_name),\n        events_json.join(\",\")\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Read the GM turn status for a play campaign.\n///\n/// GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/gm/status\n///\n/// Only the campaign owner may read this endpoint. The\n/// response includes whether the current actor is the owner\n/// (`needs_attention`), the current actor, a summary of all party members, and\n/// recent public narrations.\npub fn get_gm_status(campaign_id: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    let (owner, _status) =\n        play_campaign_owner_status(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if owner != actor {\n        return Err(PlayError::Forbidden);\n    }\n    let (current_actor, _phase, _turn_number) =\n        play_campaign_get_turn(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let members = play_campaign_members(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let narrations = play_campaign_narrations(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n\n    let needs_attention = current_actor == owner;\n\n    let mut party_json = Vec::new();\n    for (username, character_id, name, class) in members {\n        party_json.push(format!(\n            r#\"{{\"username\":\"{}\",\"character_id\":\"{}\",\"name\":\"{}\",\"class\":\"{}\"}}\"#,\n            escape_json(&username),\n            escape_json(&character_id),\n            escape_json(&name),\n            escape_json(&class)\n        ));\n    }\n\n    let mut events_json = Vec::new();\n    for (sequence, kind, event_actor, text) in narrations {\n        events_json.push(format!(\n            r#\"{{\"sequence\":{},\"kind\":\"{}\",\"actor\":\"{}\",\"text\":\"{}\"}}\"#,\n            sequence,\n            escape_json(&kind),\n            escape_json(&event_actor),\n            escape_json(&text)\n        ));\n    }\n\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"needs_attention\":{},\"current_actor\":\"{}\",\"party\":[{}],\"recent_events\":[{}]}}\"#,\n        needs_attention,\n        escape_json(&current_actor),\n        party_json.join(\",\"),\n        events_json.join(\",\")\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Submit a player action for the active turn.\n///\n/// POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/actions\n///\n/// Only the currently active player may submit an action. The action is\n/// appended as a public event and the turn passes to the DM.\npub fn submit_action(campaign_id: &str, body: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    if !play_campaign_member_exists(campaign_id, actor).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    let (current_actor, _phase, turn_number) =\n        play_campaign_get_turn(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if current_actor != actor {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n\n    let action_type = extract_string(body, \"type\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let text = extract_string(body, \"text\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if action_type.is_empty() || text.is_empty() {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n\n    let sequence = play_narration_next_sequence(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    play_narration_create(campaign_id, sequence, \"action\", actor, text)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    play_campaign_update_turn(campaign_id, \"dm\", \"dm\", turn_number)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"sequence\":{},\"kind\":\"action\",\"actor\":\"{}\",\"type\":\"{}\",\"text\":\"{}\",\"next_actor\":\"dm\"}}\"#,\n        sequence,\n        escape_json(actor),\n        escape_json(action_type),\n        escape_json(text)\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Read the current turn for a play campaign.\n///\n/// GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/turn\n///\n/// Only the campaign owner or a member may read the turn. The response\n/// includes the campaign id, current actor, phase, turn number, and the\n/// deterministic turn queue (players in join order alternating with the DM).\npub fn get_turn(campaign_id: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    let (owner, _status) =\n        play_campaign_owner_status(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if owner != actor\n        && !play_campaign_member_exists(campaign_id, actor).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?\n    {\n        return Err(PlayError::Forbidden);\n    }\n    let (current_actor, phase, turn_number) =\n        play_campaign_get_turn(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let members = play_campaign_members(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let mut queue = String::new();\n    for (i, (username, _, _, _)) in members.iter().enumerate() {\n        if i > 0 {\n            queue.push(',');\n        }\n        queue.push_str(&format!(r#\"\"{}\",\"dm\"\"#, escape_json(username)));\n    }\n    let logical_deadline = turn_number + 1;\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"campaign_id\":\"{}\",\"current_actor\":\"{}\",\"phase\":\"{}\",\"turn_number\":{},\"overdue\":false,\"logical_deadline\":{},\"queue\":[{}]}}\"#,\n        escape_json(campaign_id),\n        escape_json(&current_actor),\n        escape_json(&phase),\n        turn_number,\n        logical_deadline,\n        queue\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Nudge the current actor for a play campaign.\n///\n/// POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/turn/nudge\n///\n/// Only the campaign owner may send a nudge. The response returns the actor, the current target,\n/// the message, and the monotonically increasing nudge count for the campaign.\npub fn nudge_campaign(campaign_id: &str, body: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    let (owner, _status) =\n        play_campaign_owner_status(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if owner != actor {\n        return Err(PlayError::Forbidden);\n    }\n    let message = extract_string(body, \"message\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if message.is_empty() || actor.is_empty() {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n    let (current_actor, _phase, _turn_number) =\n        play_campaign_get_turn(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let nudge_count = play_campaign_nudge(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let sequence = play_narration_next_sequence(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    play_narration_create(campaign_id, sequence, \"nudge\", actor, &message)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"actor\":\"{}\",\"target\":\"{}\",\"message\":\"{}\",\"nudge_count\":{}}}\"#,\n        escape_json(actor),\n        escape_json(&current_actor),\n        escape_json(&message),\n        nudge_count\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Update the durable role-filtered campaign document.\n///\n/// PUT /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/document\n///\n/// Only the campaign owner may update the document. The\n/// resolution is appended as a public event and the turn advances to the next\n/// party member with an incremented turn number.\npub fn resolve_turn(campaign_id: &str, body: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    let (owner, _status) =\n        play_campaign_owner_status(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if owner != actor {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    let (current_actor, phase, turn_number) =\n        play_campaign_get_turn(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if current_actor != \"dm\" || (phase != \"dm\" && phase != \"exploration\") {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n\n    let text = extract_string(body, \"text\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if text.is_empty() || actor.is_empty() {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n\n    let members = play_campaign_members(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if members.is_empty() {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    let next_index = if phase == \"exploration\" {\n        0_usize\n    } else {\n        (turn_number % members.len() as i64) as usize\n    };\n    let next_actor = members[next_index].0.clone();\n    let new_turn_number = turn_number + 1;\n\n    let sequence = play_narration_next_sequence(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    play_narration_create(campaign_id, sequence, \"resolution\", \"dm\", text)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    play_campaign_update_turn(campaign_id, &next_actor, \"player\", new_turn_number)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"sequence\":{},\"kind\":\"resolution\",\"actor\":\"dm\",\"text\":\"{}\",\"next_actor\":\"{}\",\"turn_number\":{}}}\"#,\n        sequence,\n        escape_json(text),\n        escape_json(&next_actor),\n        new_turn_number\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Parse a play campaign scene sub-resource path.\n///\n/// For example, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/scenes/{scene_id}/enter` PlayError {\n    BadRequest,\n    NotFound,\n    Conflict,\n    Forbidden,\n}\n\n/// Parse a non-empty id that follows a fixed prefix and ends with a suffix.\n///\n/// Returns `None` if the id is empty or contains an additional `/` segment.\nfn parse_play_suffix<'a>(path: &'a str, prefix: &'a str, suffix: &'a str) -> Option<&'a str> {\n    let rest = path.strip_prefix(prefix)?;\n    let id = rest.strip_suffix(suffix)?;\n    if id.is_empty() || id.contains('/') {\n        return None;\n    }\n    Some(id)\n}\n\n/// Parse a campaign id and a nested sub-resource id from a path.\n///\n/// The path shape is `/v1/play/campaigns/{campaign_id}{marker}{sub_id}{suffix}`.\n/// Both identifiers must be non-empty and must not contain additional segments\n/// before the marker or suffix.\nfn parse_play_nested<'a>(\n    path: &'a str,\n    prefix: &'a str,\n    marker: &'a str,\n    suffix: &'a str,\n) -> Option<(&'a str, &'a str)> {\n    let rest = path.strip_prefix(prefix)?;\n    let mid = rest.find(marker)?;\n    let campaign_id = &rest[..mid];\n    if campaign_id.is_empty() {\n        return None;\n    }\n    let after = &rest[mid + marker.len()..];\n    let sub_id = after.strip_suffix(suffix)?;\n    if sub_id.is_empty() {\n        return None;\n    }\n    Some((campaign_id, sub_id))\n}\n\n/// Parse a campaign id and encounter id from an encounter sub-resource path.\nfn parse_play_encounter_base<'a>(path: &'a str, suffix: &'a str) -> Option<(&'a str, &'a str)> {\n    parse_play_nested(path, \"/v1/play/campaigns/\", \"/encounters/\", suffix)\n}\n\n/// Parse a campaign id, encounter id, and a final resource id from an encounter\n/// resource path such as `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/encounters/{enc_id}/monsters/{m_id}`.\nfn parse_play_encounter_resource<'a>(\n    path: &'a str,\n    resource: &'a str,\n) -> Option<(&'a str, &'a str, &'a str)> {\n    let (campaign_id, after) = parse_play_nested(path, \"/v1/play/campaigns/\", \"/encounters/\", \"\")?;\n    let marker = format!(\"/{}/\", resource);\n    let mid = after.find(&marker)?;\n    let encounter_id = &after[..mid];\n    let resource_id = &after[mid + marker.len()..];\n    if encounter_id.is_empty() || resource_id.is_empty() {\n        return None;\n    }\n    Some((campaign_id, encounter_id, resource_id))\n}\n\n/// Parse a play campaign id from a path like `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/members`.\npub fn parse_play_campaign_path<'a>(path: &'a str, suffix: &'a str) -> Option<&'a str> {\n    parse_play_suffix(path, \"/v1/play/campaigns/\", suffix)\n}\n\n/// Parse a play campaign recipe collection path.\n///\n/// `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/recipes` returns the campaign id.\npub fn parse_play_recipe_collection_path<'a>(path: &'a str) -> Option<&'a str> {\n    parse_play_campaign_path(path, \"/recipes\")\n}\n\n/// Parse a play campaign recipe craft path.\n///\n/// `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/recipes/{recipe_id}/craft` returns\n/// `(campaign_id, recipe_id)`.\npub fn parse_play_recipe_craft_path<'a>(path: &'a str) -> Option<(&'a str, &'a str)> {\n    parse_play_nested(path, \"/v1/play/campaigns/\", \"/recipes/\", \"/craft\")\n}\n\n/// Create a new play campaign.\n///\n/// POST /v1/play/campaigns\n///\n/// The body must contain non-empty `id` and `name` and a positive\n/// `max_players`. The caller is responsible for authorization checks;\n/// `owner` is the authenticated DM username.\npub fn create_play_campaign(body: &str, owner: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    let id = extract_string(body, \"id\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let name = extract_string(body, \"name\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let max_players = extract_int(body, \"max_players\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if id.is_empty() || name.is_empty() || max_players < 1 || owner.is_empty() {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n    if play_campaign_exists(id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    play_campaign_create(id, name, owner, \"lobby\", max_players)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"id\":\"{}\",\"name\":\"{}\",\"owner\":\"{}\",\"status\":\"lobby\",\"max_players\":{}}}\"#,\n        escape_json(id),\n        escape_json(name),\n        escape_json(owner),\n        max_players\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Join a play campaign as an authenticated player.\n///\n/// POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/members\n///\n/// A player may own at most one membership per campaign, and character IDs\n/// must be unique within a campaign. The party must not already be full.\n/// Only players are allowed to join.\npub fn join_campaign(campaign_id: &str, body: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    let character_id = extract_string(body, \"character_id\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let name = extract_string(body, \"name\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let class = extract_string(body, \"class\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if character_id.is_empty() || name.is_empty() || class.is_empty() || actor.is_empty() {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n\n    let max_players = play_campaign_max_players(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let member_count =\n        play_campaign_member_count(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if member_count >= max_players {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    if play_campaign_member_exists(campaign_id, actor).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    if play_campaign_character_id_exists(campaign_id, character_id)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?\n    {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n\n    play_campaign_member_create(campaign_id, actor, character_id, name, class)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"username\":\"{}\",\"character_id\":\"{}\",\"name\":\"{}\",\"class\":\"{}\"}}\"#,\n        escape_json(actor),\n        escape_json(character_id),\n        escape_json(name),\n        escape_json(class)\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Append a GM narration to a play campaign.\n///\n/// POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/narrations\n///\n/// Only the campaign owner may narrate. The campaign must be in the\n/// `lobby` status and have at least two party members. The first member by\n/// insertion order becomes the current actor at turn number 1.\npub fn start_campaign(campaign_id: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    let (owner, status) =\n        play_campaign_owner_status(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if owner != actor {\n        return Err(PlayError::Forbidden);\n    }\n    if status != \"lobby\" {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    let members = play_campaign_members(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if members.len() < 2 {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    let current_actor = &members[0].0;\n    play_campaign_start(campaign_id, current_actor, \"player\", 1)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"id\":\"{}\",\"status\":\"active\",\"current_actor\":\"{}\",\"turn_number\":1}}\"#,\n        escape_json(campaign_id),\n        escape_json(current_actor)\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Read the caller's player turn context for a play campaign.\n///\n/// GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/my-turn\n///\n/// Only a campaign member with role `player` may read their own context.\n/// The response includes whether it is the caller's turn, the current actor,\n/// the caller's own character (id and name only), and recent public events.\n/// DM-private document fields are never exposed.\npub fn get_my_turn(campaign_id: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    if !play_campaign_member_exists(campaign_id, actor).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::Forbidden);\n    }\n    let (current_actor, _phase, _turn_number) =\n        play_campaign_get_turn(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let (character_id, character_name) =\n        play_campaign_member_character(campaign_id, actor).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let narrations = play_campaign_narrations(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n\n    let is_my_turn = current_actor == actor;\n    let mut events_json = Vec::new();\n    for (sequence, kind, event_actor, text) in narrations {\n        events_json.push(format!(\n            r#\"{{\"sequence\":{},\"kind\":\"{}\",\"actor\":\"{}\",\"text\":\"{}\"}}\"#,\n            sequence,\n            escape_json(&kind),\n            escape_json(&event_actor),\n            escape_json(&text)\n        ));\n    }\n\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"is_my_turn\":{},\"current_actor\":\"{}\",\"character\":{{\"id\":\"{}\",\"name\":\"{}\"}},\"recent_events\":[{}]}}\"#,\n        is_my_turn,\n        escape_json(&current_actor),\n        escape_json(&character_id),\n        escape_json(&character_name),\n        events_json.join(\",\")\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Read the GM turn status for a play campaign.\n///\n/// GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/gm/status\n///\n/// Only the campaign owner may read this endpoint. {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    let (owner, _status) =\n        play_campaign_owner_status(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if owner != actor {\n        return Err(PlayError::Forbidden);\n    }\n    let (current_actor, _phase, _turn_number) =\n        play_campaign_get_turn(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let members = play_campaign_members(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let narrations = play_campaign_narrations(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n\n    let needs_attention = current_actor == owner;\n\n    let mut party_json = Vec::new();\n    for (username, character_id, name, class) in members {\n        party_json.push(format!(\n            r#\"{{\"username\":\"{}\",\"character_id\":\"{}\",\"name\":\"{}\",\"class\":\"{}\"}}\"#,\n            escape_json(&username),\n            escape_json(&character_id),\n            escape_json(&name),\n            escape_json(&class)\n        ));\n    }\n\n    let mut events_json = Vec::new();\n    for (sequence, kind, event_actor, text) in narrations {\n        events_json.push(format!(\n            r#\"{{\"sequence\":{},\"kind\":\"{}\",\"actor\":\"{}\",\"text\":\"{}\"}}\"#,\n            sequence,\n            escape_json(&kind),\n            escape_json(&event_actor),\n            escape_json(&text)\n        ));\n    }\n\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"needs_attention\":{},\"current_actor\":\"{}\",\"party\":[{}],\"recent_events\":[{}]}}\"#,\n        needs_attention,\n        escape_json(&current_actor),\n        party_json.join(\",\"),\n        events_json.join(\",\")\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Submit a player action for the active turn.\n///\n/// POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/actions\n///\n/// Only the currently active player may submit an action. The action is\n/// appended as a public event and the turn passes to the DM.\npub fn submit_action(campaign_id: &str, body: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    if !play_campaign_member_exists(campaign_id, actor).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    let (current_actor, _phase, turn_number) =\n        play_campaign_get_turn(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if current_actor != actor {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n\n    let action_type = extract_string(body, \"type\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let text = extract_string(body, \"text\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if action_type.is_empty() || text.is_empty() {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n\n    let sequence = play_narration_next_sequence(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    play_narration_create(campaign_id, sequence, \"action\", actor, text)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    play_campaign_update_turn(campaign_id, \"dm\", \"dm\", turn_number)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"sequence\":{},\"kind\":\"action\",\"actor\":\"{}\",\"type\":\"{}\",\"text\":\"{}\",\"next_actor\":\"dm\"}}\"#,\n        sequence,\n        escape_json(actor),\n        escape_json(action_type),\n        escape_json(text)\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Read the current turn for a play campaign.\n///\n/// GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/turn\n///\n/// Only the campaign owner or a member may read the turn. The response\n/// includes the campaign id, current actor, phase, turn number, and the\n/// deterministic turn queue (players in join order alternating with the DM).\npub fn get_turn(campaign_id: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    let (owner, _status) =\n        play_campaign_owner_status(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if owner != actor\n        && !play_campaign_member_exists(campaign_id, actor).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?\n    {\n        return Err(PlayError::Forbidden);\n    }\n    let (current_actor, phase, turn_number) =\n        play_campaign_get_turn(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let members = play_campaign_members(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let mut queue = String::new();\n    for (i, (username, _, _, _)) in members.iter().enumerate() {\n        if i > 0 {\n            queue.push(',');\n        }\n        queue.push_str(&format!(r#\"\"{}\",\"dm\"\"#, escape_json(username)));\n    }\n    let logical_deadline = turn_number + 1;\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"campaign_id\":\"{}\",\"current_actor\":\"{}\",\"phase\":\"{}\",\"turn_number\":{},\"overdue\":false,\"logical_deadline\":{},\"queue\":[{}]}}\"#,\n        escape_json(campaign_id),\n        escape_json(&current_actor),\n        escape_json(&phase),\n        turn_number,\n        logical_deadline,\n        queue\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Nudge the current actor for a play campaign.\n///\n/// POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/turn/nudge\n///\n/// Only the campaign owner may send a nudge. A player member\n/// receives only the public `story` field; `dm_notes` is never disclosed.\npub fn get_document(campaign_id: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    let (owner, _status) =\n        play_campaign_owner_status(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let is_owner = owner == actor;\n    let is_member =\n        play_campaign_member_exists(campaign_id, actor).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if !is_owner && !is_member {\n        return Err(PlayError::Forbidden);\n    }\n    let (story, dm_notes) =\n        play_campaign_document_get(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if is_owner {\n        Ok(format!(\n            r#\"{{\"story\":\"{}\",\"dm_notes\":\"{}\"}}\"#,\n            escape_json(&story),\n            escape_json(&dm_notes)\n        ))\n    } else {\n        // Players see only the public story; dm_notes is omitted entirely.\n        Ok(format!(r#\"{{\"story\":\"{}\"}}\"#, escape_json(&story)))\n    }\n}\n\n/// Submit a GM resolution for the active turn.\n///\n/// POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/resolutions\n///\n/// Only the campaign owner may resolve when the current phase is `dm`. The\n/// resolution is appended as a public event and the turn advances to the next\n/// party member with an incremented turn number.\npub fn resolve_turn(campaign_id: &str, body: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    let (owner, _status) =\n        play_campaign_owner_status(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if owner != actor {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    let (current_actor, phase, turn_number) =\n        play_campaign_get_turn(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if current_actor != \"dm\" || (phase != \"dm\" && phase != \"exploration\") {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n\n    let text = extract_string(body, \"text\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if text.is_empty() || actor.is_empty() {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n\n    let members = play_campaign_members(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if members.is_empty() {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    let next_index = if phase == \"exploration\" {\n        0_usize\n    } else {\n        (turn_number % members.len() as i64) as usize\n    };\n    let next_actor = members[next_index].0.clone();\n    let new_turn_number = turn_number + 1;\n\n    let sequence = play_narration_next_sequence(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    play_narration_create(campaign_id, sequence, \"resolution\", \"dm\", text)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    play_campaign_update_turn(campaign_id, &next_actor, \"player\", new_turn_number)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"sequence\":{},\"kind\":\"resolution\",\"actor\":\"dm\",\"text\":\"{}\",\"next_actor\":\"{}\",\"turn_number\":{}}}\"#,\n        sequence,\n        escape_json(text),\n        escape_json(&next_actor),\n        new_turn_number\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Parse a play campaign scene sub-resource path.\n///\n/// For example, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/scenes/{scene_id}/enter` The destination\n/// must be a valid outbound connection from the party's current location.\n/// The location graph and current scene remain unchanged; the party's current\n/// location is updated to the destination.\npub fn travel_turn(campaign_id: &str, body: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    if !play_campaign_member_exists(campaign_id, actor).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    let }\n\n    let destination_id = extract_string(body, \"destination_id\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if destination_id.is_empty() {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n\n    let turns) in destinations {\n        if to_id == destination_id {\n            travel_turns = turns;\n            found = true;\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    if !found {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n\n    let sequence = play_narration_next_sequence(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    play_narration_create(campaign_id, sequence, \"travel\", actor, &destination_id)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    play_campaign_update_turn(campaign_id, \"dm\", \"dm\", turn_number)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    play_campaign_set_current_location(campaign_id, &destination_id)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"sequence\":{},\"kind\":\"travel\",\"actor\":\"{}\",\"destination_id\":\"{}\",\"travel_turns\":{},\"next_actor\":\"dm\"}}\"#,\n        sequence,\n        escape_json(actor),\n        escape_json(&destination_id),\n        travel_turns\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Take a short or long rest as the active player's turn.\n///\n/// POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/turn/rest\n///\n/// Only the return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n\n    let (hp_current, hp_max) =\n        play_campaign_member_hp(campaign_id, actor).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let new_hp = if rest_type == play_shop_get(campaign_id, settlement_id, shop_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let mut stock = parse_shop_stock(&stock_json)?;\n    let mut new_stock = 0;\n    let mut pos = None;\n -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    if
